title: Course descriptions, Bachelor of Science, Advanced Program in Computer Science
issuer: Viet Nam National University – Ho Chi Minh City, University of Science, Faculty of Information Technology
notes: Shared by Dũng (F8) on 9 November 2026; no public URL.
The printed page numbers equal the PDF page numbers. Every page repeats a two-column letterhead, which the extraction drops.

Course codes are the 2021 ones (CS161, CS162, CM101); the 2024 and 2025 curricula use CS160 and CM102 and add courses the booklet does not describe (CS252, CS323, CS414, CS435, CS468 and the BAA general-education courses).
The booklet prints no Vietnamese names, no assessment and no offering terms.
CS386 (page 128) repeats the description of CS486 (page 22) under another code; both are kept as printed.
"Prior-course" is printed verbatim as prerequisites_printed. It is not a rule: the rule engine never reads it (AGENTS.md hard rule 1).
